senses.en: used after a number to say the hour

ex.en: The gates close at six o'clock.
ex.zh: 大门六点钟关。

ex.en: Please be in the lab at nine o'clock, not ten past, because the demonstration starts on time.
ex.zh: 请九点到实验室，不要九点十分，演示会准时开始。

tip: 只跟整点：three o'clock。3:15 不说 three fifteen o'clock。参考表标成名词，本卡按副词。

senses.en: starting at a place, time, or source

ex.en: This postcard is from my cousin in Nanjing.
ex.zh: 这张明信片是南京的表哥寄来的。

ex.en: Ideas from different subjects can be combined when students explain a real problem in their town.
ex.zh: 学生解释家乡的真实问题时，可以结合不同学科的想法。

tip: from...to... 表示从……到……，时间和地点都可以用。

senses.en: ornaments such as rings and necklaces

ex.en: She keeps jewellery in a locked box.
ex.zh: 她把珠宝放在上锁的盒子里。

ex.en: The museum does not allow jewellery near the open tanks, because a ring can fall in.
ex.zh: 博物馆不允许珠宝靠近敞开的水箱，因为戒指可能掉进去。

col: a piece of jewellery｜一件珠宝
tip: 英式 jewellery 不可数。一件说 a piece of jewellery。美式 jewelry 已另列。
note: 英式拼写。美式 jewelry 已在库里，不共用文件。

senses.en: the town or city where you grew up

ex.en: His hometown is a small port.
ex.zh: 他的家乡是一个小港口。

ex.en: She returns to her hometown every spring to see the people who taught her to read.
ex.zh: 她每年春天回乡，去看教她识字的那些人。

tip: hometown 是一个词。故乡的国土感更强时可用 homeland。

senses.en: having a lot of rain

ex.en: A rainy Monday kept us indoors.
ex.zh: 下雨的星期一让我们待在室内。

ex.en: On rainy days the team practises in the hall and leaves the muddy field alone.
ex.zh: 雨天队伍在礼堂训练，不去动那片泥地。

tip: rainy 形容天气或季节。下雨的动作是 rain。降雨量 rainfall 本库另有一条。

senses.en: a piece of clothing hanging from the waist

ex.en: Her skirt caught on the back of the chair.
ex.zh: 她的裙子挂在了椅背上。

ex.en: The costume skirt is too long for the dance, so a parent will hem it tonight.
ex.zh: 演出的裙子跳舞太长，今晚会有家长把它改短。

tip: 裙子是 skirt。衬衫是 shirt。只差一个字母。

senses.en: a woman who serves food in a restaurant

ex.en: The waitress recommended the soup.
ex.zh: 女服务员推荐了汤。

ex.en: Thank the waitress when the plate arrives, and ask her to repeat a word you did not catch.
ex.zh: 盘子端上来时向女服务员道谢，没听清的词请她再说一遍。

col: a friendly waitress｜和气的女服务员
work as a waitress｜当女服务员
tip: waitress 指女性。和本批的 waiter 成对。性别不明时用 server 更稳妥。

senses.en: trousers of strong cotton cloth

ex.en: He wore jeans under the lab coat.
ex.zh: 他在实验服里面穿了牛仔裤。

ex.en: The jeans had a hole at one knee, so he changed before the interview.
ex.zh: 牛仔裤有一边膝盖破了，所以面试前他换了衣服。

col: a pair of jeans｜一条牛仔裤
tip: jeans 作复数。一条牛仔裤是 a pair of jeans，不是 a jeans。

senses.en: a long curved yellow fruit

ex.en: She shared a banana with her deskmate.
ex.zh: 她和同桌分了一根香蕉。

ex.en: The banana in his bag was too ripe, and it left a brown mark on the notebook.
ex.zh: 他包里的香蕉太熟了，在笔记本上留下一块褐色印子。

col: a bunch of bananas｜一串香蕉
tip: 一根香蕉是 a banana。一串是 a bunch of bananas。

senses.en: belonging to her

ex.en: The green bag is hers, not mine.
ex.zh: 绿包是她的，不是我的。

ex.en: I picked up two coats, then remembered the grey one is hers and put it back.
ex.zh: 我拿起两件外套，忽然想起灰的那件是她的，就放了回去。

col: a friend of hers｜她的一个朋友
tip: hers 后面不再加名词。her book 用 her，the book is hers 用 hers。

senses.en: used for a point in time or place

ex.en: We meet at the school gate at seven.
ex.zh: 我们七点在校门口见面。

ex.en: Looking at screens late at night can make it harder for teenagers to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 深夜看屏幕会让青少年更难入睡。

tip: 钟点和较小地点用 at；街道、城市一般用 in。

senses.en: a container for cut flowers

ex.en: The vase holds three branches.
ex.zh: 花瓶里插着三根枝条。

ex.en: Move the vase off the piano before rehearsal, because a bump would send water onto the keys.
ex.zh: 排练前把花瓶从钢琴上挪走，碰一下水就会洒到琴键上。

tip: 英式 vase 常读 /vɑːz/，美式常读 /veɪs/。两种都对，跟词条音标走。

senses.en: to do something repeatedly in order to improve

ex.en: Practise the scale before the song.
ex.zh: 唱歌之前先练音阶。

ex.en: Musicians practise slowly at first, then raise the speed only when the notes stay clean.
ex.zh: 乐手起初练得很慢，只有音符仍然干净时才把速度加上去。

tip: practise 是英式动词。名词练习是 practice，已在库里。美式也用 practice 作动词。practise doing，不说 practise to do。

senses.en: a person who plays or writes music

ex.en: A musician from the city band played at the fair.
ex.zh: 市乐队的一位乐师在集市上演奏。

ex.en: The musician stopped twice so the students could copy the rhythm on the board.
ex.zh: 乐师停了两次，让学生把节奏抄到黑板上。

tip: musician 是人。music 是音乐，musical 可以是音乐剧或形容词。

senses.en: a large shop that sells food and other goods

ex.en: The supermarket closes at ten.
ex.zh: 超市十点关门。

ex.en: We met at the supermarket entrance because the bus stop beside it has a roof.
ex.zh: 我们在超市门口见面，因为旁边的公交站有棚。

tip: 在超市购物用 at the supermarket。比它小的食品店是 a grocery。

senses.en: a soft red fruit eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: Slice one tomato for the noodles.
ex.zh: 切一个番茄下面条。

ex.en: The cook washed every tomato under the tap, then kept the soft ones for soup.
ex.zh: 厨师把每个番茄都在水龙头下洗了，软的留着做汤。

col: a slice of tomato｜一片番茄
tip: 复数是 tomatoes，要加 es，不是 tomatos。

senses.en: a person from another country

ex.en: A foreigner asked the way to the museum.
ex.zh: 一位外国人问路去博物馆。

ex.en: The foreigner visiting the school shared a song from home, and the class learned the chorus.
ex.zh: 来学校访问的外国朋友分享了家乡的一首歌，全班学会了副歌。

col: a foreigner abroad｜在国外的外国人
treat a foreigner kindly｜善待外国人
tip: foreign 已在库里。foreigner 是人。写作时具体、尊重，不要用这个词去贴刻板印象。

senses.en: a flying vehicle with wings and an engine

ex.en: The airplane landed ten minutes early.
ex.zh: 飞机早到了十分钟。

ex.en: From the airplane the river looked like a silver line between dark fields.
ex.zh: 从飞机上看，河像一条银线，夹在深色的田野之间。

tip: 美式拼作 airplane。英式常作 aeroplane。坐飞机是 by airplane。
note: 美式拼写。英式 aeroplane 不在这一窗口里。

senses.en: used to introduce a clause
the one already mentioned

ex.en: I think that the answer is right.
ex.zh: 我认为这个答案是对的。

ex.en: Researchers argue that regular sleep is as important as extra lessons for students under exam pressure.
ex.zh: 研究者认为，对备考压力大的学生来说，规律睡眠和额外补课一样重要。

tip: 引导宾语从句的 that 可以省略，但写作里保留更清楚。

senses.en: a light frame covered with paper or cloth, flown in the wind

ex.en: The kite caught in the tree.
ex.zh: 风筝挂在了树上。

ex.en: Hold the kite until the wind is steady, then let the line out a little at a time.
ex.zh: 等风稳定了再抓住风筝，然后一次放出一点线。

tip: 高考里 kite 几乎总是风筝。它也可以是一种鸟，那不是这条的重点。放风筝注意电线。

senses.en: mathematics, in British English

ex.en: Maths homework is on page 40.
ex.zh: 数学作业在第 40 页。

ex.en: She likes maths because a wrong step can be found and corrected on the same line.
ex.zh: 她喜欢数学，因为错的一步能在同一行里找出来改掉。

tip: 英式 maths 带 s，仍作单数：maths is fun。美式 math 已在库里，不合并。
note: 英式 maths。美式 math 已另列。

senses.en: to say hello, or to react to something in a particular way

ex.en: Greet guests at the door by name.
ex.zh: 在门口按名字问候客人。

ex.en: The crowd did not greet the news with cheers; they waited to hear the full score.
ex.zh: 人群没有用欢呼迎接这个消息，他们等着听完整比分。

col: greet the new year｜迎接新年
tip: greet sb。名词 a greeting。贺卡上的 greetings 常用复数。

senses.en: used for the future, or for willingness
a desire, or a legal document about one's property

ex.en: I will call you after the meeting.
ex.zh: 散会后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: A city that will face water shortages needs to teach children why saving water matters.
ex.zh: 一座将面临缺水的城市，需要让孩子明白为什么节水重要。

tip: will 表示将来或意愿；遗嘱这一名词读音相同，写作里要靠词性区分。

senses.en: a folding cover on a stick that keeps off rain

ex.en: Take an umbrella; the sky is dark.
ex.zh: 带把伞，天阴了。

ex.en: Her umbrella turned inside out in the wind, so they shared mine for the last block.
ex.zh: 她的伞被风吹翻了，最后一条街我们合用我的。

tip: 伞是 umbrella。雨伞雨天用。阳伞也可以是 umbrella 或 parasol。

senses.en: used for an agent, a deadline, or a means

ex.en: The poster was drawn by our art group.
ex.zh: 这张海报是我们美术小组画的。

ex.en: Please hand in the form by Friday so that the school can arrange seats before the test.
ex.zh: 请在周五前交表，以便学校在考试前排好座位。

tip: by 加交通工具时不用冠词：by bus。截止时间也用 by。

senses.en: a piece of clothing for the legs, used as a plural

ex.en: Those grey trousers need a hem.
ex.zh: 那条灰裤子需要改裤脚。

ex.en: Pack a dry pair of trousers for the field walk, because the grass stays wet until noon.
ex.zh: 野外步行再带一条干裤子，因为草到中午还是湿的。

col: a pair of trousers｜一条裤子
tip: trousers 是复数，动词用 are。一条裤子说 a pair of trousers。美式常说 pants。

senses.en: intended for someone, or lasting a length of time

ex.en: This seat is for our class monitor.
ex.zh: 这个座位是给我们班长的。

ex.en: Schools that set aside time for reading often see students become more willing to discuss difficult texts.
ex.zh: 留出阅读时间的学校，常常发现学生更愿意讨论难懂的文章。

col: for a long time｜很长时间
tip: for 接一段时间；since 接时间点。

senses.en: a sweet brown fizzy drink

ex.en: He bought a bottle of coke after practice.
ex.zh: 训练后他买了一瓶可乐。

ex.en: The machine only had coke and water, so the team shared two cold bottles.
ex.zh: 机器里只有可乐和水，于是队员们分了两瓶冰的。

col: a can of coke｜一罐可乐
tip: 参考表这一行是「可口可乐」。品牌写法常大写 Coke。焦炭是另一个意思，本卡不收。

senses.en: not the same
used to describe several separate people, things, or types

ex.en: Each student has a different style.
ex.zh: 每个学生都有不同风格。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

senses.en: a book of plain or lined paper for writing notes

ex.en: Leave the notebook open at page six.
ex.zh: 笔记本翻开到第六页放着。

ex.en: His notebook holds the dates of every match, written in pencil so he can correct them.
ex.zh: 他的笔记本用铅笔记下每场比赛的日期，方便修改。

col: take out a notebook｜拿出笔记本
tip: 纸质笔记本是 notebook。笔记本电脑也可以叫 a notebook，看上下文。

senses.en: an activity you do for pleasure

ex.en: Her hobby is collecting used stamps.
ex.zh: 她的爱好是收集用过的邮票。

ex.en: He turned a hobby into a small repair service for classmates' radios.
ex.zh: 他把爱好做成了一项小活，给同学修收音机。

col: take up a hobby｜开始一项爱好
hobby horse｜木马；反复念叨的话题
tip: 爱好是 hobby，复数 hobbies。职业才是 job 或 career。

senses.en: used to make a verb or phrase negative

ex.en: I am not ready for the oral test.
ex.zh: 我还没准备好口语考试。

ex.en: A short plan is not a waste of time if it stops you from revising the same page twice.
ex.zh: 如果一份简短计划能避免你把同一页复习两遍，它就不是浪费时间。

tip: 否定动词用 not；直接否定名词用 no，如 no time。

senses.en: on the subject of, or roughly

ex.en: We talked about the class trip.
ex.zh: 我们谈了班级出游的事。

ex.en: Reports about teenage sleep suggest that earlier school starts can harm attention in morning lessons.
ex.zh: 关于青少年睡眠的报告表明，过早上学可能影响上午课堂的注意力。

tip: be about to do 表示马上要做，通常不再加具体将来时间。

senses.en: a small sweet biscuit

ex.en: He saved a cookie from lunch for the bus ride.
ex.zh: 他把午餐的一块小甜饼留到坐车时吃。

ex.en: The cookie broke in his pocket, and the crumbs covered the reading list.
ex.zh: 小甜饼在口袋里碎了，碎屑沾满了阅读清单。

tip: 美式 cookie 大致等于英式 biscuit。参考表写「小甜饼」。

senses.en: covered with clouds

ex.en: It is cloudy, so the solar panel is idle.
ex.zh: 天多云，所以太阳能板闲着。

ex.en: A cloudy morning can still become bright, which the weather diary from last May shows in three lines.
ex.zh: 多云的早晨后来仍可能放晴，去年五月的天气日记用三行字记下了这种情况。

tip: cloud 已在库里。cloudy 是形容词。比较级 cloudier。它也可以比喻「不清楚」，但天气义最常用。

senses.en: the legal status of belonging to a country

ex.en: Write your nationality in capitals.
ex.zh: 国籍用大写字母填写。

ex.en: Nationality is not the same as the language you speak at home.
ex.zh: 国籍和你在家里说的语言不是一回事。

tip: nationality 是国籍。民族有时用 nation 或 ethnic group。What's your nationality? 问的是哪国人。

senses.en: a straight tool for measuring, or a person who governs

ex.en: Bring a ruler for the geometry test.
ex.zh: 几何测验带一把尺子。

ex.en: The chapter compares a ruler who listens to the council with one who decides alone.
ex.zh: 这一章比较了听议会的统治者和独自做决定的统治者。

col: a 30-centimetre ruler｜一把 30 厘米的尺子
a ruler of the country｜国家的统治者
tip: 尺子和统治者是同一个词。画直线、统治都是动词 rule。看句子才能确定是哪一个。

senses.en: one of the hard white parts in the mouth

ex.en: I chipped a tooth on a piece of ice.
ex.zh: 我咬冰块时崩了一小块牙。

ex.en: The dentist said the back tooth needed a filling, not to be pulled.
ex.zh: 牙医说后面那颗牙需要补，不必拔。

tip: 复数 teeth，不是 tooths。刷牙用 teeth。

senses.en: a long soft seat for two or more people

ex.en: The cat sleeps on the sofa arm.
ex.zh: 猫睡在沙发扶手上。

ex.en: We moved the sofa away from the heater so the cloth would not dry and fade.
ex.zh: 我们把沙发从暖气旁挪开，免得布面发干褪色。

tip: sofa 和 couch 都很常见。两人以上的长沙发才是 sofa，单人软椅是 armchair。

senses.en: a small animal with long ears

ex.en: A rabbit crossed the path behind the dorm.
ex.zh: 一只兔子穿过宿舍后面的小路。

ex.en: The science room keeps a rabbit in a large cage and feeds it hay twice a day.
ex.zh: 科学教室的大笼子里养着一只兔子，一天喂两次干草。

tip: rabbit 是兔子。hare 是野兔，耳朵更长。

senses.en: to take something for a time and then return it

ex.en: May I borrow your ruler for this question?
ex.zh: 这道题我可以借你的尺子用一下吗？

ex.en: She borrowed a charger until lunch and returned it before the afternoon class.
ex.zh: 她把充电器借到午饭，下午课前还了。

tip: borrow 是借入。lend 是借出。借东西的人 borrow，物主 lend。

senses.en: a flat board fixed to a wall for storing things

ex.en: The atlas belongs on the shelf by the window.
ex.zh: 地图册应放在靠窗的架子上。

ex.en: The top shelf is too high for the younger students, so the dictionaries stay lower.
ex.zh: 顶层搁板对低年级学生太高，所以词典放在下面。

tip: 复数 shelves。在架子上用 on the shelf。

senses.en: an informal talk

ex.en: They had a long conversation about books.
ex.zh: 他们就书籍进行了长时间交谈。

ex.en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
ex.zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。

tip: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

senses.en: a thick food made from milk

ex.en: Yogurt and oats make a quick breakfast.
ex.zh: 酸奶加燕麦就是一份很快的早餐。

ex.en: Keep the yogurt cold on the trip, or it will separate and taste sharp by the time you unpack.
ex.zh: 路上要把酸奶冷藏，不然等你打开时它会分层，味道也发冲。

col: a pot of yogurt｜一杯酸奶
tip: yogurt 是美式拼写，英式常写 yoghurt。它通常不可数，一杯可以说 a pot of yogurt。

senses.en: to be able to, or to be allowed to
a metal container for food

ex.en: I can finish this exercise before lunch.
ex.zh: 我能在午饭前做完这道练习。

ex.en: Public libraries can give students a quiet place to work when their homes are too crowded.
ex.zh: 当家里太挤时，公共图书馆可以为学生提供安静的学习场所。

tip: 能力用 can；过去的能力常用 could 或 was able to。

senses.en: a grandfather, used as a family name for him

ex.en: Grandpa waters the beans every dawn.
ex.zh: 爷爷每天天亮给豆子浇水。

ex.en: My grandpa tells the same river story, and my cousins still sit still for it.
ex.zh: 我外公总讲同一个江上的故事，表兄妹们仍然会坐着听完。

col: grandpa and grandma｜爷爷奶奶；外公外婆
tip: grandpa 是口语。书面语用 grandfather。奶奶、外婆是 grandma 或 granny。

senses.en: a child's word for mother

ex.en: The little boy said, "Mommy, look at this."
ex.zh: 小男孩说：「妈妈，看这个。」

ex.en: She still says mommy when she is tired, though she writes mother on the school form.
ex.zh: 她累的时候仍叫 mommy，虽然在学校表格上写的是 mother。

tip: mommy 是儿童口语，美式很常见。mom 与 mum 已在本库，正式写作可用 mother。
note: 口语。美式常说 mommy 或 mom；英式常用 mummy 或 mum。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, often carried from home
to eat that kind of meal

ex.en: A picnic needs more water than cake.
ex.zh: 野餐需要的水比蛋糕多。

ex.en: We picnic by the lake only when the path is dry, and we carry every wrapper home.
ex.zh: 只有小路干了我们才在湖边野餐，而且每个包装都带回家。

tip: go on a picnic 或 have a picnic。动词过去式 picnicked，要加 k。

senses.en: a child's toy in the shape of a person

ex.en: A doll sat on the empty seat of the bus.
ex.zh: 一个玩偶坐在公共汽车的空座位上。

ex.en: The child would not leave the doll at the lost-property desk, so her mother waited.
ex.zh: 孩子不肯把玩偶留在失物处，于是她妈妈等着。

tip: doll 是玩具娃娃。洋娃娃也用这个词。

senses.en: together with, or having

ex.en: I walk home with my classmate.
ex.zh: 我和同学一起走回家。

ex.en: Teams that plan a project with a clear timetable are less likely to leave the hard work until the last night.
ex.zh: 用清晰时间表规划项目的小组，不太会把难的部分留到最后一夜。

col: with the help of｜在……的帮助下
tip: with 后面接名词或代词，不接动词原形。

senses.en: a pain in the head

ex.en: Bright light gives me a headache.
ex.zh: 强光让我头疼。

ex.en: She left at half-time because the headache made it hard to follow the ball.
ex.zh: 她中场就走了，因为头疼得看不清球。

tip: have a headache 要有 a。复数 headaches。

senses.en: a flying insect that makes honey

ex.en: A bee landed on the lemonade and nobody moved.
ex.zh: 一只蜜蜂落在柠檬水上，谁都没动。

ex.en: The keeper told us a bee stings only once, then showed the hive from behind glass.
ex.zh: 饲养员告诉我们蜜蜂只会蜇一次，然后隔着玻璃给我们看蜂箱。

col: busy as a bee｜忙个不停
tip: 复数 bees。不要写成 been 或 beer。

senses.en: on the condition that, or whether

ex.en: If it rains, we will stay in the classroom.
ex.zh: 如果下雨，我们就留在教室。

ex.en: If schools teach students how to check a source, they are less likely to trust a false story online.
ex.zh: 如果学校教学生如何核对来源，他们就不太会轻信网上的假消息。

tip: 主将从现：if 从句常用一般现在时，主句用 will。

senses.en: a small restaurant that serves drinks and simple meals

ex.en: The café by the station sells soup.
ex.zh: 车站旁的小餐馆卖汤。

ex.en: We met at the café after rehearsal and shared one pot of tea between four people.
ex.zh: 排练后我们在咖啡馆见面，四个人合喝一壶茶。

tip: 考纲词头是 café，目录 id 用 cafe，因为文件名不能带音符。cafeteria 是自助食堂，不是同一词。
note: 词头保留考纲里的 café。目录 id 是 cafe，复用同 id 的上游文件。

senses.en: a person who works on a ship

ex.en: The sailor retied the wet rope before the tide turned.
ex.zh: 涨潮前水手把那根湿绳子又系好了。

ex.en: An old sailor showed us which cloud means the wind will change before dark.
ex.zh: 一位老水手告诉我们，哪种云说明天黑前风会变。

col: an experienced sailor｜有经验的水手
tip: sailor 是在船上工作的人。去航海是 go sailing。

senses.en: a game in which two teams hit a ball over a high net

ex.en: Volleyball practice starts at four.
ex.zh: 排球训练四点开始。

ex.en: They moved volleyball indoors after the wind kept lifting the ball over the fence.
ex.zh: 风老是把球吹过围栏，他们就把排球挪到室内。

tip: 球类名前通常不加 the：play volleyball。场地才说 a volleyball court。

senses.en: a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal

ex.en: Her bicycle has a bell and a small light.
ex.zh: 她的自行车有铃，还有一盏小灯。

ex.en: He locks his bicycle beside the gym because the rack by the gate is already full.
ex.zh: 他把自行车锁在体育馆旁边，因为门口的车架已经满了。

tip: 口语里也说 bike。骑自行车是 ride a bicycle，不是 drive。

senses.en: a seed of a climbing plant, eaten as food

ex.en: A single bean sprouted in the cotton wool.
ex.zh: 一颗豆子在棉花里发了芽。

ex.en: The soup has beans and rice, and it is the dish most students ask for on Thursdays.
ex.zh: 这汤里有豆子和米饭，是多数学生星期四要点的菜。

tip: bean 是豆。咖啡豆也叫 coffee bean。

senses.en: material made by weaving

ex.en: Cover the table with a clean cloth before you set out the paint.
ex.zh: 摆颜料之前先用一块干净的布把桌子铺上。

ex.en: The cloth for the costumes is still in the box, folded and unmarked.
ex.zh: 戏服的布还在箱子里，叠着，没有做记号。

tip: cloth 是布。clothes 是衣服，已经在词库里，不要看混。

senses.en: an animal with a long tail that climbs trees

ex.en: A monkey grabbed the banana from the guide's hand.
ex.zh: 一只猴子从导游手里抢走了香蕉。

ex.en: The monkey house was closed for cleaning, so we watched the birds instead.
ex.zh: 猴馆在打扫，关着，于是我们改去看鸟。

tip: monkey around 是胡闹，不是「在猴子周围」。

senses.en: inside a place, or during a period

ex.en: The keys are in my schoolbag.
ex.zh: 钥匙在我的书包里。

ex.en: Students who read in short daily sessions often remember new words longer than those who study only before an exam.
ex.zh: 每天分段阅读的学生，往往比只在考前突击的人记得更久。

tip: 地点或一段时间前常用 in；具体某一天用 on，钟点用 at。

senses.en: a small jumping animal that lives in and near water

ex.en: A frog sat on a leaf in the pond.
ex.zh: 一只青蛙坐在池塘的叶子上。

ex.en: Frogs are quiet in the daytime, then the pond gets loud after the lights go out.
ex.zh: 青蛙白天安静，灯灭之后池塘就吵了。

tip: 青蛙是 frog。蟾蜍是 toad。复数 frogs。

senses.en: bright with sunlight

ex.en: It is sunny, so the match can stay outside.
ex.zh: 天气晴朗，比赛可以留在室外。

ex.en: The sunny side of the dorm is hot by noon, and we close the curtain.
ex.zh: 宿舍朝阳的一面到中午就热，我们把窗帘拉上。

tip: sunny 形容天气或地方光线好。人开朗也可以说 a sunny smile。

senses.en: a person who lives next door or nearby

ex.en: Our neighbour watered the plants.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居给植物浇了水。

ex.en: Ask a neighbour to take the parcel if you will be in the lab all afternoon.
ex.zh: 要是你整个下午都在实验室，就请邻居代收包裹。

tip: neighbour 是英式拼写。美式 neighbor 已在库里，不要并成一条。形容词 neighbouring，名词 neighbourhood。

senses.en: an insect with large coloured wings

ex.en: A butterfly landed on the open book.
ex.zh: 一只蝴蝶落在摊开的书上。

ex.en: Butterflies gather near the bush in May, which is why the art class sketches there.
ex.zh: 五月蝴蝶聚在那丛灌木旁，所以美术课在那里写生。

tip: 复数 butterflies。胃里发慌可以说 butterflies in one's stomach。

senses.en: a small green or purple fruit that grows in bunches

ex.en: A sour grape made her blink.
ex.zh: 一颗酸葡萄让她眨了眨眼。

ex.en: She rinsed every grape before packing lunch, because the market fruit still had dust on the skin.
ex.zh: 她把每颗葡萄洗过再装进午饭，因为集市上的水果皮上还有灰。

col: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄
tip: grape 常以复数 grapes 出现。一串是 a bunch of grapes。葡萄柚 grapefruit 是另一种水果。

senses.en: a man who serves food in a restaurant

ex.en: The waiter brought extra napkins.
ex.zh: 服务员又拿来了餐巾。

ex.en: Ask the waiter to repeat the dish if the name is unclear, rather than guessing from the picture.
ex.zh: 菜名如果看不清，就请服务员再说一遍，不要对着图片猜。

tip: waiter 传统上指男性。性别不明时可以说 server。女服务员 waitress 在本批后面。

senses.en: the one near the speaker

ex.en: This question is easier than the last one.
ex.zh: 这道题比上一道容易。

ex.en: This result suggests that short breaks can improve attention during long study hours.
ex.zh: 这一结果说明，长时间学习中的短休息有助于保持注意力。

tip: this 指近处或即将说到的事；those 是 that 的复数。

senses.en: something that shows a rule
A person or action that others can learn from or copy

ex.en: Give an example to support your idea.
ex.zh: 举一个例子支持你的观点。

ex.en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

tip: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

senses.en: cheerful and lively

ex.en: A merry song ended the show.
ex.zh: 一首欢快的歌结束了演出。

ex.en: The merry crowd stayed on the lawn until the lights over the stage went out.
ex.zh: 欢快的人群留在草地上，直到舞台上方的灯灭了。

tip: Merry Christmas 是固定说法。merry 比 happy 更热闹。副词 merrily。

senses.en: to enjoy or want
similar to

ex.en: I like reading by the window.
ex.zh: 我喜欢靠窗读书。

ex.en: Teenagers like being trusted with real tasks, not only praised for high marks.
ex.zh: 青少年喜欢被托付真正的任务，而不只是因为高分受到夸奖。

tip: like 后接 doing 表示习惯喜好；would like to do 表示此刻想要。

senses.en: to have the same opinion
Decide something together or promise to do something

ex.en: I agree with your suggestion.
ex.zh: 我同意你的建议。

ex.en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点
agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致
agree to do something｜答应做某事
agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

senses.en: to such a degree, or therefore
and for that reason

ex.en: The hallway was so noisy that we could not hear.
ex.zh: 走廊吵得我们听不见。

ex.en: The town has few buses, so many students cycle to school even on cold mornings.
ex.zh: 镇上公交很少，所以许多学生即使在寒冷的早晨也骑车上学。

tip: so...that... 表示“如此……以至于”；such 后面接名词。

senses.en: hard to do
Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.

ex.en: The question is difficult.
ex.zh: 这道题很难。

ex.en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。

col: a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

senses.en: a thin wooden stick with graphite for writing

ex.en: Sharpen the pencil before the test starts.
ex.zh: 开考前把铅笔削好。

ex.en: She kept a spare pencil in the box because the first one broke during the drawing.
ex.zh: 她在盒子里留了一支备用铅笔，因为第一支在画图时断了。

tip: 铅笔是 pencil。钢笔是 pen。用铅笔写是 write in pencil。

senses.en: a funny drawing, or an animated film

ex.en: The cartoon on the notice board shows our principal with a megaphone.
ex.zh: 布告栏上的漫画画着校长拿着扩音器。

ex.en: We watched a short cartoon about recycling, then wrote down three facts from it.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于回收的短卡通，然后写下其中三件事实。

tip: cartoon 既可以是纸上的漫画，也可以是动画片。

senses.en: a piece of cloth for drying skin or dishes

ex.en: Hang the wet towel on the rail.
ex.zh: 把湿毛巾挂在杆上。

ex.en: There was no clean towel in the washroom, so he dried his hands on a paper sheet.
ex.zh: 洗手间没有干净毛巾，他用一张纸把手擦干。

tip: 毛巾是 towel。塔是 tower。不要看混。

senses.en: the whole number or amount

ex.en: All the lights in the lab are off.
ex.zh: 实验室里的灯都关了。

ex.en: Not all famous people are suitable role models for teenagers who are still forming their own values.
ex.zh: 对仍在形成价值观的青少年来说，并非所有名人都是合适的榜样。

tip: all 与 not 连用常表示部分否定：Not all students agree.

senses.en: a very short time ago, or only

ex.en: I have just seen the notice on the board.
ex.zh: 我刚看到布告栏上的通知。

ex.en: A slogan that just sounds exciting may still fail if it does not tell people what to do.
ex.zh: 一句只是听着振奋的口号，如果没有告诉人们该做什么，仍然可能没有用。

tip: just 常放在助动词后、实义动词前。

senses.en: touching a surface, or on a particular day

ex.en: The notice is on the classroom door.
ex.zh: 通知贴在教室门上。

ex.en: Many cities now limit cars on weekdays in order to cut air pollution around schools.
ex.zh: 许多城市现在工作日限行，以减少学校周边的空气污染。

tip: 星期、具体日期用 on；钟点用 at，上午/年/月用 in。

senses.en: to say what something is like

ex.en: Can you describe the scene in detail?
ex.zh: 你能详细描述那个场景吗？

ex.en: The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.
ex.zh: 该报告描述了公共公园的可达性如何影响人口密集城市居民的体育活动。

col: describe something in detail｜详细描述某事物
describe something as｜把某事物形容为
describe a process｜描述一个过程
tip: 说describe something to someone，不说describe someone something。

senses.en: in the role of, or while something happens
while, or because

ex.en: She works as a library assistant after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后在图书馆当助理。

ex.en: As cities grow, schools have to find new ways to give every child a safe route to class.
ex.zh: 随着城市扩大，学校必须找到新办法，让每个孩子都有安全的上学路线。

tip: as 可表示“作为”或“当……时”；like 更常用于口语中的“像”。

senses.en: a plant grown for food

ex.en: Soup needs at least one green vegetable.
ex.zh: 汤里至少要有一种绿色蔬菜。

ex.en: The market sells vegetable seedlings in spring, and students grow them in pots.
ex.zh: 春天市场卖菜苗，学生们用花盆来种。

tip: vegetable 里的 e 在日常发音里常常很轻。复数 vegetables。

senses.en: a book that lists words and their meanings

ex.en: Look the word up in a dictionary, then write your own sentence.
ex.zh: 先在词典里查这个词，再写你自己的句子。

ex.en: A bilingual dictionary sits on the front desk, and it is chained so it stays there.
ex.zh: 前台放着一本双解词典，用链子拴着，免得被人拿走。

col: look sth up in a dictionary｜在词典里查
tip: dictionary 是词典。查词是 look up a word。

senses.en: a group of sentences about one point

ex.en: Start a new paragraph when the speaker changes.
ex.zh: 说话的人变了，就另起一段。

ex.en: The last paragraph of her report gives the numbers, and the rest explains how she got them.
ex.zh: 她报告的最后一段给出数字，其余部分解释这些数字怎么来的。

tip: paragraph 是文章的段。缩进或空行用来分开。

senses.en: the number 1, or a single person or thing
a single person or thing

ex.en: I need one more pencil for the test.
ex.zh: 我考试还需要一支铅笔。

ex.en: One reason cities plant trees along roads is that shade can lower the temperature in summer.
ex.zh: 城市沿路种树的一个原因是，树荫能降低夏天的气温。

tip: one of 后面接复数名词，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: the act or result of cutting someone's hair

ex.en: His new haircut looks much shorter.
ex.zh: 他的新发型看起来短了不少。

ex.en: I need a haircut before the photo morning, so I booked the shop beside the school gate.
ex.zh: 拍照那天早上之前我得理个发，所以预约了校门口旁边的店。

tip: haircut 是一次理发或理完的样子。动词用 cut one's hair 或 have one's hair cut。

senses.en: to own, or to experience something
used with a past participle

ex.en: We have a maths test tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们明天有一场数学测验。

ex.en: Students who have a regular place to study at home usually find it easier to start homework on time.
ex.zh: 家里有固定学习角落的学生，通常更容易按时开始写作业。

tip: have to do 表示客观上不得不；must 更强调主观认为必须。

senses.en: in this place

ex.en: Please wait here until your name is called.
ex.zh: 请在这里等到叫你的名字。

ex.en: Communities that plant trees here, along the hottest streets, can make walking to school safer.
ex.zh: 在最热的街道旁种树的社区，可以让步行上学更安全。

tip: Here is / Here are 后面的主语决定动词单复数。

senses.en: a strong thick cord

ex.en: Hold the rope with both hands on the way down.
ex.zh: 下去的时候用两只手抓住绳子。

ex.en: The rope around the tent pegs was loose, and one corner lifted in the wind.
ex.zh: 围着帐篷桩的绳子松了，一个角被风掀了起来。

col: a piece of rope｜一根绳子
tip: rope 比 string 粗。跳绳可以说 jump rope 或 skip。

senses.en: to make a liquid flow from a container

ex.en: Pour the tea slowly so it doesn't spill.
ex.zh: 茶要慢慢倒，免得洒出来。

ex.en: Rain poured down the gym roof and the match moved inside after ten minutes.
ex.zh: 雨从体育馆屋顶倾泻下来，比赛十分钟后改到室内。

tip: pour 是倒液体。人多时用 crowd，不用 pour 形容人除非是涌入。

senses.en: used to stress something surprising

ex.en: Even a short walk can clear your head.
ex.zh: 即使是短短的散步也能让头脑清醒。

ex.en: Even a rich city can have neighbourhoods where children have no safe park nearby.
ex.zh: 即使是富裕的城市，也可能有孩子附近没有安全公园的社区。

tip: even 放在所强调的词前；even if 后面接让步从句。

senses.en: a figure of a person or animal made of stone or metal

ex.en: A stone statue stands in the middle of the square.
ex.zh: 广场中央立着一尊石像。

ex.en: Pigeons sat on the head of the statue until the cleaners came with a ladder.
ex.zh: 鸽子停在雕像头上，直到清洁工扛着梯子来了。

col: a statue of a poet｜诗人雕像
tip: 参考表这一行的中文写成了「法令，法规」，那是 statute。statue 是雕像。音标 /ˈstætjuː/ 对得上雕像，本卡保留。

senses.en: to plan how something looks or works
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: They will design a new school logo.
ex.zh: 他们将设计一个新的校徽。

ex.en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。

col: be designed to do something｜旨在做某事
tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: to order that something must not be done

ex.en: House rules forbid shoes on the mat.
ex.zh: 家规禁止把鞋踩上垫子。

ex.en: Teachers forbid students to run in the lab, and a broken rule can mean leaving the room.
ex.zh: 老师禁止学生在实验室里跑，违反规定可能就要离开房间。

col: forbid sb to do｜禁止某人做
tip: forbid sb to do sth。过去式 forbade，过去分词 forbidden。prohibit 更正式，结构是 prohibit sb from doing。

senses.en: a wooden musical instrument held under the chin

ex.en: The violin needs a new string.
ex.zh: 这把小提琴需要一根新弦。

ex.en: She practised the violin in a storage room so the dormitory could stay quiet.
ex.zh: 她在储藏室练小提琴，好让宿舍保持安静。

tip: 演奏乐器通常加 the：play the violin。拉小提琴的人是 violinist。

senses.en: a covering for the hand with separate parts for the fingers

ex.en: One glove is missing from the pair.
ex.zh: 这双手套少了一只。

ex.en: Wear a glove on the hand that holds the hot tray, and use a cloth on the other.
ex.zh: 拿热托盘的那只手戴手套，另一只手用布。

col: a pair of gloves｜一副手套
tip: 手套常用复数 gloves。一副是 a pair of gloves。无指的连指手套是 mittens。

senses.en: wanting more than one's fair share

ex.en: A greedy bite left nothing for the others.
ex.zh: 一大口吃下去，别人就没了。

ex.en: The story punishes the greedy king, who keeps every coin and loses his friends.
ex.zh: 故事惩罚了贪婪的国王：他留下每一枚硬币，也失去了朋友。

tip: be greedy for money / food。名词 greed。反义是 generous。

senses.en: to make the sounds of a word
to state a decision officially

ex.en: Pronounce the last consonant clearly.
ex.zh: 把最后一个辅音发清楚。

ex.en: The principal will pronounce the holiday dates on Friday, once the office has checked the calendar.
ex.zh: 校长将在周五宣布放假日期，等办公室先把日历核对完。

tip: pronounce 在课堂上多是「发音」，也可以是正式的「宣布」。名词 pronunciation 重音不同，本批另有一条。

senses.en: skill or power to do something

ex.en: Language ability grows with practice.
ex.zh: 语言能力随练习而增长。

ex.en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
ex.zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。

col: the ability to learn｜学习能力
develop an ability｜培养一种能力
tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。
